title: THE WINDSURF GAMBIT
lede: Seventy-two hours in July 2025: OpenAI's exclusivity clock ran out, Google wired $2.4 billion for the founders, the company was declared dead on arrival — and Cognition bought what was left before Monday's all-hands. It may be the fastest consequential M&A in AI history.
body:
h2. THE SETUP

p. Windsurf — originally founded as %(cyan)Codeium% — had rebuilt itself in late 2024 as the first genuinely 'agentic' IDE: the Cascade agent, the Tab prediction engine, inline awareness of whatever the developer was doing. By mid-2025 it had $82M ARR, 350+ enterprise customers, and hundreds of thousands of daily active users. OpenAI spent spring 2025 circling a ~$3B acquisition.

h2. THE WEEKEND

table(specs).
|_. when|_. what happened|
|spring 2025|OpenAI's ~$3B acquisition talks run on an exclusivity clock — and expire|
|fri jul 11|Google announces a $2.4B 'reverse acquihire': CEO Varun Mohan, co-founder Douglas Chen, and research leads go to DeepMind; the license goes to Google|
|fri, after 5pm PT|Cognition president Russell Kaplan makes the first call to the remaining Windsurf leadership|
|mon jul 14|definitive agreement signed — Cognition acquires Windsurf entire|

p. The part that belongs in a museum case: Cognition did not get a husk. It got %(hl)the product, the trademark, the IP, the enterprise book, and the whole team% — roughly 250 people who had just watched their CEO leave on a Friday and needed a reason to believe by Monday. Jeff Wang — who had been running the company for three days as interim CEO — came with the deal.

h2. WHAT COGNITION ACTUALLY BOUGHT

* %(amber)The IDE% — the last missing surface. Devin did asynchronous delegation; Windsurf did synchronous acceleration. Agents for the backlog, an editor for the work you keep.
* %(amber)Cascade% — the in-editor agent that SWE models were trained against.
* %(amber)Tab% — passive prediction tuned for latency; its engine became the SWE-1-mini tier.
* %(amber)The GTM machine% — enterprise ARR that was doubling quarter-over-quarter, with under 5% customer overlap with Devin's book.
* %(amber)Full Claude access% restored — Google's deal had complicated it; the acquisition notes explicitly restored it.

bq. Combined enterprise ARR at Cognition is up over 30% in the seven weeks post buying Windsurf. %(dim)— Cognition, September 2025 raise announcement%

h2. THE EPILOGUE: DEVIN DESKTOP

p. In %(ok)June 2026%, Cognition did the final move: renamed Windsurf to %(hl)Devin Desktop%. One brand, one agent, two tempos — the IDE for the work you drive, the cloud agents for the work you delegate. The IDE Cognition rescued in a weekend became the front half of the Devin product line.

p. The model thread woven through this story — Windsurf had already shipped its own SWE-1 family a month before the acquisition — continues in the "SWE-1 exhibit":swe-1.html.
